notes: MXW6 is a battery-powered Microflex Wireless boundary microphone transmitter (available as MXW6/O omnidirectional, MXW6/C cardioid, and white variants MXW6W/O, MXW6W/C). It has only two physical connectors: a 1/8" (3.5mm) earphone jack (dual-mono output, for monitoring a return/translation channel routed from the Audio Network Interface) and a USB 3.0 Type A "charge connector" used exclusively to dock with the Networked Charging Station (MXWNCS2/4/8) or SBC10-USB wall charger for charging the internal Li-ion battery — it is not a general-purpose USB data/host port, so no USB data grade is set. The internal microphone capsule is fixed/non-removable and is not a physical port. There is no separate DC barrel or mains power inlet; the unit is battery-only. Specs confirmed via the official Shure "MXW User Guide" (pubs.shure.com/view/guide/MXW/en-US.pdf), which contains the MXW6-specific spec block (dimensions 23 x 44 x 114 mm, weight 108 g, battery life up to 7-8 hours) plus the shared Transmitters spec block listing "Headphone/Earphone Output: 3.5 mm (1/8"), dual mono" and "Charge Connector: USB 3.0 Type A". Desktop/tabletop unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted).
